title: Tech Gets Hammered On AI Disappointments While Small Caps Benefit From Lower Yields, Strong GDP Data: Oct. 29, 2026
summary: Tech stocks are getting hammered after Google and Microsoft disappointed shareholders during their earnings calls with heavy AI capex bills weighing on free cash flows and calling into question whether the monumental investments will prove to be worth it.
